prop GroupSetting(A nonempty_set, mul fn(x, y A) A, one A, inv fn(x A) A):
    forall u, v, w A:
        mul(mul(u, v), w) = mul(u, mul(v, w))
    forall u A:
        mul(one, u) = u
        mul(u, one) = u
        mul(inv(u), u) = one
        mul(u, inv(u)) = one

thm group_left_cancel:
    ? forall A nonempty_set, mul fn(x, y A) A, one A, inv fn(x A) A, a A, b A, c A:
        $GroupSetting(A, mul, one, inv)
        mul(a, b) = mul(a, c)
        =>:
            b = c
    mul(inv(a), a) = one
    b = mul(one, b) = mul(mul(inv(a), a), b) = mul(inv(a), mul(a, b)) = mul(inv(a), mul(a, c)) = mul(mul(inv(a), a), c) = mul(one, c) = c
